A train leaves Austin at 9am going 60 mph. Another leaves Dallas (195 miles away) at 10am going 80 mph toward Austin. At what time do they meet? Show your work briefly.

samples.text:
Let’s say they meet at time t hours after 9 a.m.

Then the first train has traveled 60t miles.

The second train has traveled 80(t-1) miles.

When they meet, the sum of their distances traveled is 195 miles.

So:

60t + 80(t-1) = 195

60t + 80t - 80 = 195

140t = 275

t = 275/140 = 55/28 = 1.964 hours after 9 a.m.

So they meet at 9:00 a.m. + 1.964 hours = 10:58 a.m.
